metadata.title: The checkout that stopped.
metadata.description: A coupon rollout went live. Purchases started failing. Find the cause, restore the service, and prove your fix.
metadata.briefing: Welcome to Northstar Commerce, a fictional independent retail platform. Release R42 enabled coupon_v2 and purchases started failing. You are the engineer on the incident. Maya owns the platform and Leo understands the product contract. Inspect evidence, choose a simulated mitigation, repair the rollout, and verify the result. Only deliberate evidence opens and operations advance logical time; reading, chat and notes are free. The attempt ends at 20 simulated minutes. Scores reward diagnosis (20), outcome (40), verification (20), structured communication (10), and judgment (10). These are practice mechanics, not business forecasts.
objectives: Restore the enabled v2 coupon contract
Align the origin and cache configuration

teammates.name: Maya
teammates.persona: Pragmatic and careful. Ask for observations before changes.
teammates.fallback: I can help inspect the available platform evidence. Open an artifact first so we can discuss what it actually shows.
teammates.welcome: The checkout alert began after R42. Let’s establish the impact and inspect the logs.

teammates.name: Leo
teammates.persona: Precise about contracts and customer outcomes.
teammates.fallback: I can discuss the product contract once its evidence is open. Let’s avoid guessing what the configuration contains.
teammates.welcome: R42 changed the coupon contract. We need to restore purchases and demonstrate the enabled rollout works.

artifacts.title: Checkout error logs
artifacts.body:
HISTORICAL INCIDENT EVIDENCE · t=0
09:42 release=R42 feature=coupon_v2 enabled=true
09:43 request=cart-721 route=/checkout coupon=true ERROR ConfigSchemaError: discount_bps absent
09:43 request=cart-722 route=/checkout coupon=false status=200
09:44 cohort=100 purchases coupon_requests=30 failed=30 successful=70 p95_ms=900
The error appears only on coupon requests. This excerpt describes the incident baseline, not the current dashboard.

artifacts.title: Coupon configuration & contract
artifacts.body:
HISTORICAL INCIDENT EVIDENCE · t=0
source,schema,value
origin,1,percent=10
shared_cache,1,percent=10
R42_reader,2,discount_bps=1000

Reviewed migration payload: schema=2; discount_bps=1000. Publishing changes the origin only. The shared configuration cache has an independent lifecycle; it reloads from the origin when explicitly invalidated. A process restart does not clear this shared cache. A $100 coupon cart must total $90.

artifacts.title: R42 release notes
artifacts.body:
HISTORICAL INCIDENT EVIDENCE · t=0
R42: Introduce coupon_v2 with basis-point discounts. Prerequisite: publish schema 2 configuration and refresh the shared cache.
R41 and coupon_v2=false use an independent valid legacy coupon store. Both can mitigate an incident while investigation continues. Rollback preserves flags and configuration. The objective is to restore R42 with the new feature enabled, not remain on the legacy path.

facts.text: The alert began after R42; coupon requests are affected.
Coupon requests report ConfigSchemaError: discount_bps absent; ordinary requests succeed.
The origin and shared cache both use schema 1; the R42 reader requires schema 2 with discount_bps=1000. Publication changes origin; explicit invalidation reloads the shared cache.
R41 and a disabled coupon_v2 flag use a separate valid legacy store; restart preserves the shared cache.

action_catalog.label: Set coupon feature flag
action_catalog.description: Switch between the legacy and v2 coupon paths. This may affect purchase success.

action_catalog.label: Select application release
action_catalog.description: Change the running release. Flags and shared configuration are preserved.

action_catalog.label: Restart checkout processes
action_catalog.description: Perform a simulated rolling restart. Shared configuration is preserved.

action_catalog.label: Publish reviewed configuration
action_catalog.description: Publish the reviewed configuration to the simulated origin.

action_catalog.label: Refresh shared configuration cache
action_catalog.description: Reload the shared cache from its current origin.

action_catalog.label: Test the v2 coupon contract
action_catalog.description: Run an isolated $100 coupon-cart fixture against the current v2 path.

action_catalog.label: Observe two workload ticks
action_catalog.description: Measure two deterministic workload ticks with the current release and flag.

diagnosis_choices.label: Checkout exhausted its database connection pool
The rollout omitted its configuration-contract migration
The payment gateway is timing out on all purchases

rubric.explanation: R42 requires schema 2 but its rollout omitted the configuration migration. Origin and shared cache initially retained schema 1. A legacy path safely mitigates failures. Publish the reviewed schema, reload the cache, re-enable v2, then verify its $90 contract and two healthy ticks. Restarting processes cannot change the shared configuration.

hints.text: Inspect the error logs and compare the failing requests with the successful ones.
Compare the reader contract, the origin configuration, and the shared cache. Which pieces change together?
